memory_schedule.formula: M(k)=ceil(log2(k))+2 for the evaluated powers of two

probability_space.structured_outer: one fixed authenticated constituent reused in every row
probability_space.random_outer: one uniform full-rank matched-size constituent sampled once and reused in every row
probability_space.routing: independent uniform row-coordinate and transposed-region permutations
probability_space.inner: independent RandomStepConv maps sampled once and shared by all messages

limitations: These curves cover occupation one only and are not full distance-certificate margins.
Nearest binary64 arithmetic is not outward rounded.
Random constituents are compared only with the structured constituent of the same block size and dimension.
